# [PATCH] Make sure an autogenerated version has at least four parts

| Header | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **From** | Sam Vilain <sam.vilain@catalyst.net.nz> |
| **To** | Junio C Hamano <junkio@cox.net> |
| **Date** | 2007-05-21T14:52:21+12:00 |
| **Message-ID** | [11797159411969-git-send-email-sam.vilain@catalyst.net.nz](https://lore.kernel.org/git/11797159411969-git-send-email-sam.vilain@catalyst.net.nz) |

---

**Thread**: [thread](./02-52-21.thread.md#:~:text=2007/05/21/02-52-21)

Otherwise, a custom "v1.5.2.42.gd00b" is considered newer than a
"v1.5.2.1.69.gcafe".

Warning: contains awk.

Signed-off-by: Sam Vilain <sam.vilain@catalyst.net.nz>
---
```
 GIT-VERSION-GEN |    2 +-
 1 files changed, 1 insertions(+), 1 deletions(-)

```

```diff
diff --git a/GIT-VERSION-GEN b/GIT-VERSION-GEN
index 06c360b..5eb58c3 100755
--- a/GIT-VERSION-GEN
+++ b/GIT-VERSION-GEN
@@ -18,7 +18,7 @@ elif test -d .git &&
 	v[0-9]*) : happy ;;
 	esac
 then
-	VN=$(echo "$VN" | sed -e 's/-/./g');
+	VN=$(echo "$VN" | awk -F- 'X=$1 { Y=$2; Z=$3; while (!(X ~ /\..*\..*\./)) { X = X ".0" } print X ( Y ? "." Y : "" ) ( Z ? "." Z : "" ) }');
 else
 	VN="$DEF_VER"
 fi
-- 
```

1.5.1.1.175.g31e4
